title: The Limits of Inference Scaling Through Resampling
paper_type_zh: 不完美 verifier 与重采样上限研究
best_for_zh: 研究 rejection sampling、verifier 误接受、测试时计算扩展与推理数据审计的读者
one_line: Audits verifier-gated code resampling with weak and extended unit tests, showing that more attempts can preserve false positives and make a finite or zero budget optimal.
该研究用原始单元测试作为弱验收器、用 EvalPlus 扩展测试进行追溯审计，表明增加重采样次数仍会保留错误代码，并可能使有限预算乃至零预算最优。
why: Rejection-sampled reasoning data are only as reliable as their acceptance gate; this work makes verifier precision, generator capability, task difficulty, and sampling budget explicit audit dimensions.
inclusion_reason: A direct audit of verifier-gated rejection sampling that shows why data builders must retain attempt order, weak- and strong-verifier outcomes, false-positive costs, and stopping budgets instead of treating every accepted rollout as correct.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Verifier-gated resampling is often summarized as “sample until one answer passes.” This paper asks when that procedure can actually close the gap between a weak and a strong generator when the acceptance test is incomplete. Its empirical object is an ordered set of Python solutions for HumanEval+ or MBPP+: each record links a task and model to a candidate, its sampling attempt, the original-test decision, the extended-test decision, and a true-positive or false-positive label. Original HumanEval/MBPP tests are the operational gate; the stronger EvalPlus suites are used only for retrospective auditing.

The work is therefore an evaluation and failure analysis, not a new training corpus or an LLM-training recipe. It belongs in the data-construction and release-recipe track because rejection-sampled datasets inherit exactly this acceptance contract: if builders retain only weak-verifier passes, increasing generation volume can increase apparent yield without establishing correctness. The official repository releases analysis code and sample bundles, but release completeness, exact lineage, checksums, and output-data licensing remain only partially documented.

由 verifier 把关的重采样通常被概括为“持续采样，直到某个答案通过”。本文追问：当验收测试不完备时，这一过程是否真能弥合弱生成器与强生成器之间的差距。其实验数据对象是 HumanEval+ 或 MBPP+ 上按顺序生成的一组 Python 解答；每条记录把任务和模型与候选代码、采样轮次、原始测试结果、扩展测试结果以及真阳性或假阳性标签关联起来。原始 HumanEval/MBPP 测试负责实际验收，更强的 EvalPlus 测试只用于事后审计。

因此，这项工作是评测与失效分析，而不是新的训练语料或 LLM 训练配方。它与数据构造和开放发布配方轨道直接相关，因为 rejection sampling 数据集继承了同样的验收契约：如果构造者只保留弱 verifier 通过的样本，增加生成量可能提高表面产量，却不能证明正确性。官方仓库发布了分析代码和样本包，但发布完整性、精确 lineage、校验和与输出数据许可仍只有部分说明。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central quantity is conditional correctness after the weak verifier accepts a candidate. Unlimited resampling lets the weak model approach the probability that an accepted sample is truly correct; it does not erase verifier false positives. Consequently, if a strong model's single-sample correctness exceeds the weak model's correctness conditional on passing the verifier, the weak model cannot catch up through resampling alone, even with an infinite budget.

Finite-budget behavior also depends on utility. The analysis gives a true positive benefit of 1, a rejected-all-candidates outcome value of 0, and negative values to false positives. A larger K raises the chance of finding a true positive, but also raises exposure to falsely accepted programs. Because easy tasks tend to be solved earlier, repeated rejections concentrate the remaining population on harder tasks, where false positives are relatively more likely. The resulting optimum may be small, and can be K=0 when accepting an incorrect answer is sufficiently costly.

核心量是候选被弱 verifier 接受之后的条件正确率。无限重采样只能让弱模型趋近于“已通过 verifier 的样本中真正正确的概率”，并不会消除 verifier 的假阳性。因此，如果强模型单次采样的正确率高于弱模型通过 verifier 后的条件正确率，那么即使预算无限，弱模型也无法仅靠重采样追平强模型。

有限预算下的行为还取决于效用。分析将真阳性收益设为 1、所有候选均被拒绝的收益设为 0，并为假阳性赋予负值。增大 K 一方面提高找到真阳性的机会，另一方面也增加错误程序被误接受的暴露面。由于容易任务往往更早解决，连续拒绝会使剩余任务集中到更难的部分，而这些任务相对更容易产生假阳性。因此最优 K 可能很小；当错误接受的代价足够高时，最优值甚至可以是 0。

title: Method
方法
html:
For HumanEval+, the authors analyze at least 200 samples per task and model for most models and 1,000 for Command Light; MBPP+ uses 50 samples per task and model. Sampling temperature is 0.8 with EvalPlus defaults otherwise. The pool combines previously released EvalPlus samples for several open models with newly collected samples for Llama 3.1, Phi-3, GPT-4o, and Cohere Command-family models.

Within a budget K, candidates are traversed in order until the first one passes the original tests. The extended suite then classifies that accepted program as a true or false positive. For each K up to 200, the finite-budget study randomly permutes the same stored candidates 1,000 times and evaluates utilities at false-positive cost-benefit ratios 0, 1, 2, 4, and 8. The theoretical appendix models easy and hard task mixtures to explain why conditioning on prior rejection changes the remaining task distribution.

A separate RACE-based branch samples 50 solutions per task, model, and instruction at temperature 0.8 and checks camelCase, snake_case, line-length, and line-comment requirements. The official repository provides analysis notebooks and three linked sample archives for HumanEval+, MBPP+, and code quality. It exposes no tagged release or consolidated manifest; exact API snapshots, seeds, dates, and comprehensive checksums are unknown.

在 HumanEval+ 上，多数模型的每个任务至少分析 200 个样本，Command Light 为 1,000 个；MBPP+ 的每个任务和模型使用 50 个样本。采样温度为 0.8，其余设置沿用 EvalPlus 默认值。样本池同时包含多个开放模型此前发布的 EvalPlus 样本，以及为 Llama 3.1、Phi-3、GPT-4o 和 Cohere Command 系列新采集的样本。

给定预算 K，流程按顺序检查候选，遇到第一个通过原始测试的候选即停止；扩展测试随后把这一候选标为真阳性或假阳性。对每个不超过 200 的 K，有限预算实验将同一批已存储候选随机重排 1,000 次，并在假阳性成本收益比为 0、1、2、4、8 时计算效用。理论附录用容易任务与困难任务的混合模型解释：以先前拒绝为条件会改变剩余任务的分布。

另一条基于 RACE 的代码质量分支，在温度 0.8 下，对每个任务、模型和指令采样 50 个解答，检查 camelCase、snake_case、行长度和行注释要求。官方仓库提供分析 notebook，并链接 HumanEval+、MBPP+ 和代码质量三份样本压缩包；但没有带标签的 release 或统一 manifest，精确 API 快照、随机种子、请求日期和完整校验和均未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The reported scaling curves show an inverse relationship between a model's single-sample accuracy and the correctness of its samples conditional on passing the limited tests. In both HumanEval+ and MBPP+, models below the paper's cutoff cannot match GPT-4o's single-sample accuracy through unlimited weak-verifier resampling. This is evidence about the verifier-generator pair, not proof that any released sample set is intrinsically high quality.

The finite-budget experiments make the practical risk concrete. At a false-positive cost-benefit ratio of 4, Figure 4 reports an optimal K no larger than 5 for all four displayed models; at larger costs, the optimum can be 0. False-positive rates rise with K because later unresolved tasks are systematically harder. On task subsets whose verifier precision is below 90%, the paper counts 70 of 150 HumanEval+ tasks and 128 of 321 MBPP+ tasks, and reports an even stronger relationship.

The code-quality branch reports that false positives perform worse across all tested compliance measures; this supports a link between functional false positives and the measured style failures, but not broad claims about simplicity or maintainability. A manual inspection of ten false positives—five per benchmark—found logical errors, missed edge cases, and inefficient implementations. The paper also excludes suspected oracle-mismatch tasks rather than silently treating the extended tests as infallible: 14 from HumanEval+ and 57 from the post-EvalPlus MBPP+ pool.

论文报告的扩展曲线显示，模型的单次采样准确率与其“通过有限测试后的条件正确率”呈反向关系。在 HumanEval+ 和 MBPP+ 上，低于论文所示阈值的模型无法依靠无限次弱 verifier 重采样追平 GPT-4o 的单次采样准确率。这是针对特定 verifier—生成器组合的证据，不是对任何已发布样本集内在质量的证明。

有限预算实验进一步显示实际风险。当假阳性成本收益比为 4 时，图 4 中四个模型的最优 K 均不大于 5；成本更高时，最优 K 可以为 0。假阳性率会随 K 上升，因为后期尚未解决的任务系统性地更难。在 verifier 精度低于 90% 的任务子集中，论文统计了 150 个 HumanEval+ 任务中的 70 个和 321 个 MBPP+ 任务中的 128 个，并报告了更强的相关关系。

代码质量分支报告，假阳性在所有被测合规指标上都更差；这支持“功能性假阳性与已测风格失败相关”，但不能推出关于简洁性或可维护性的广泛结论。作者人工检查了十个假阳性样本，每个基准五个，发现了逻辑错误、边界情况遗漏和低效实现。论文也没有把扩展测试默认为绝对正确，而是排除疑似 oracle 不匹配任务：HumanEval+ 排除 14 个，完成 EvalPlus 初始清理后的 MBPP+ 再排除 57 个。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is not another pass@k curve. It separates the acceptance verifier from a stronger audit oracle and asks whether selection actually closes a generalization gap. That distinction exposes a ceiling determined by conditional correctness, whereas evaluation with the same tests used for selection would report only that a candidate passed the gate.

The paper also joins three pieces that are often treated separately: an infinite-budget limit, a finite-budget utility analysis, and a task-mixture explanation for rising false-positive risk after repeated rejection. This turns “more test-time compute” from a monotone assumption into an auditable stopping problem. Relative to broad reward-overoptimization arguments, the unit-test setup gives a programmatic, record-level contract that can be reconstructed from candidate order and paired weak/strong test outcomes.

本文的贡献并非再画一条 pass@k 曲线。它把负责验收的 verifier 与更强的审计 oracle 分离，并检验筛选是否真正缩小泛化差距。这个区分揭示了由条件正确率决定的上限；如果仍用同一套验收测试做评测，得到的只会是“候选通过了门槛”。

论文还把通常被分开讨论的三部分联系起来：无限预算上限、有限预算效用分析，以及连续拒绝后任务混合改变、假阳性风险上升的解释。由此，“更多测试时计算”不再是单调有益的假设，而成为可以审计的停止问题。相较于更宽泛的 reward overoptimization 论述，这里的单元测试设定给出了程序化、记录级的契约，可由候选顺序和成对的弱/强测试结果重建。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The empirical results cover code generation on HumanEval+/MBPP+ with human-authored unit tests. The theory may be domain-agnostic, but transfer to mathematical reasoning, LLM-generated tests, learned judges, tool-using agents, or interactive environments is not demonstrated. Prompt sensitivity, training contamination, candidate dependence, repair loops, diversity selection, and verifier refinement are not evaluated.

Extended EvalPlus tests are treated as the stronger correctness oracle, yet the authors also identify and remove suspected oracle mismatches. Remaining false negatives or false positives would alter the estimated ceiling. The utility study varies hypothetical false-positive costs; it does not estimate real deployment costs or define a universally safe precision threshold.

Reproducibility is partial. The repository releases code and three sample bundles, but exact API model snapshots, request dates, random seeds, a complete task/model/attempt manifest, and archive checksums are not documented. MIT and Apache-2.0 notices cover repository code and inherited components, but the license for all newly generated outputs is unknown. No tagged immutable release was visible when checked.

实证结果只覆盖 HumanEval+/MBPP+ 代码生成和人工编写的单元测试。理论虽可能不依赖领域，但论文并未验证其能迁移到数学推理、LLM 生成测试、学习型 judge、工具调用智能体或交互环境。提示词敏感性、训练污染、候选间依赖、修复循环、多样性选择和 verifier 改进也未被评估。

EvalPlus 扩展测试被当作更强的正确性 oracle，但作者同时识别并排除了疑似 oracle 不匹配。残留的假阴性或假阳性都会改变上限估计。效用实验改变的是假设性的假阳性成本，并未估计真实部署成本，也没有给出普适的安全精度阈值。

复现条件仅部分完备。仓库发布了代码和三份样本包，却没有记录精确 API 模型快照、请求日期、随机种子、完整的任务—模型—尝试 manifest 以及压缩包校验和。MIT 与 Apache-2.0 声明覆盖仓库代码和继承组件，但所有新生成输出的许可证仍未知。检查时也未看到带标签的不可变 release。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the data-construction and open-release-recipes track, this paper supplies a concrete audit schema for verifier-filtered reasoning data. A useful release should preserve every candidate's task, generator and version, attempt order, weak-verifier result, stronger-audit result, acceptance budget K, stopping rule, and any false-positive cost used for selection. Publishing only accepted answers destroys the evidence needed to estimate conditional correctness or detect selection-induced shifts toward harder tasks.

The study can guide pre-release stress tests: stratify verifier precision by task and generator, plot true- and false-positive rates against K, compare against a stronger held-out verifier, and report utility sensitivity rather than a single success metric. Its results warn against treating benchmark gains under the same acceptance tests as evidence of data quality. They also motivate retaining rejected and near-miss samples, since those records reveal how the selected distribution changes over the course of resampling.

This card should not be used as evidence that all rejection sampling fails or that K=5 is universal. The numerical optimum depends on the generator, verifier, task mixture, and cost model. The transferable contribution is the audit procedure and the requirement to document the feedback contract.

对“数据构造与开放发布配方”轨道而言，本文给出了 verifier 筛选推理数据的具体审计模式。一个可审计的发布应保留每个候选的任务、生成器及版本、尝试顺序、弱 verifier 结果、更强审计结果、验收预算 K、停止规则，以及选择所采用的假阳性成本。只发布通过验收的答案，会丢失估计条件正确率和发现任务分布向更难样本偏移所需的证据。

这项研究可用于设计发布前压力测试：按任务和生成器分层统计 verifier 精度，绘制真阳性率与假阳性率随 K 的变化，用更强的留出 verifier 对照，并报告效用对成本假设的敏感性，而不是只给单一成功率。结果也提醒读者，使用同一套验收测试得到的基准增益不能证明数据质量；同时应保留被拒绝样本和近失误样本，因为它们能够揭示重采样过程中入选分布如何变化。

本卡片不能被用来声称所有 rejection sampling 都会失败，也不能把 K=5 当作通用规则。数值最优点取决于生成器、verifier、任务混合与成本模型。可迁移的贡献是审计程序，以及完整记录反馈契约的要求。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the verifier as part of the data-generating process: original tests decide retention, while extended tests only audit retained candidates.
  • Distinguish pass probability from conditional correctness. More passes can coexist with a persistent or rising false-positive rate.
  • Treat Figure 3 as a ceiling for a specific generator-verifier pair, not a universal ranking of models or datasets.
  • Treat the K<=5 result at cost-benefit ratio 4 as an experimental scenario, not a default stopping rule.
  • Check the appendix exclusions before reusing aggregate counts: the final analyzed sets contain 150 HumanEval+ and 321 MBPP+ tasks.
  • For reuse, obtain or create an immutable manifest with model snapshots, sample order, paired test outcomes, seeds, archive hashes, and explicit output-data licensing.

• 把 verifier 视为数据生成过程的一部分：原始测试决定保留，扩展测试只审计已保留候选。
  • 区分通过概率与条件正确率；通过样本变多，并不排除假阳性率持续存在或上升。
  • 把图 3 理解为特定生成器—verifier 组合的上限，而非模型或数据集的普遍排名。
  • 成本收益比为 4 时 K≤5 是一个实验场景，不是默认停止规则。
  • 复用总计数前先检查附录的排除规则：最终分析集含 150 个 HumanEval+ 和 321 个 MBPP+ 任务。
  • 实际复用时，应补建不可变 manifest，记录模型快照、样本顺序、成对测试结果、随机种子、压缩包哈希和明确的输出数据许可。
